description:
Moves the experimental **Vertical** Home viewer button into Reddit's bottom navigation bar, so it follows the bar when it hides on scroll. It remains a separate optional patch.

Captures post links through their shared model getter as well as the list mapper. This addresses the "Vertical feed unavailable: IllegalStateException" result when the Home feed used a direct mapping path. If Home still has no matching links, the message now reports the number of rendered sections and cached links for diagnosis.

The viewer uses the posts already loaded in Home and stops at the end of that set. Normal post taps are unchanged. Device verification is still needed.
